likutay-moharan: The magnum opus of Rebbe Nachman — 411 profound Torah teachings covering every aspect of spiritual life. The foundation of Breslov Chassidus.
kitzur-likutay-moharan: R' Nosson's concise summary of each Torah in Likutay Moharan — perfect for quick review or as an entry point to the deeper teachings.
sefer-hamidos: The Book of Character Traits — alphabetical guide to 108 topics of personal development, from Truth to Humility, with practical advice.
sipurey-maasiyos: The famous 13 mystical stories of Rebbe Nachman — enchanted tales of lost princesses, humble woodcutters, and hidden spiritual worlds.
sichos-haran: Rebbe Nachman's informal conversations and guidance — practical spiritual advice on prayer, joy, simplicity, and faith.
shivchay-haran: Accounts of Rebbe Nachman's extraordinary life, journeys, and holy conduct as told by his closest students.
chayey-moharan: The life of Rebbe Nachman as recorded by R' Nosson — biographical accounts, teachings, and the Rebbe's final days in Uman.
likutay-halachos: R' Nosson's monumental 8-volume work revealing the deep Breslov connections within the entire Code of Jewish Law.
likutay-tefilos: 211 original prayers by R' Nosson, each one drawn from a teaching in Likutay Moharan — the heartfelt voice of a devoted student.
tefilos-haboker: Tefilos HaBoker — morning prayers compiled by R’ Efraim ben R’ Naftali, based on Likutay Halachos, with cleaned publish-ready Hebrew and English paragraphs.
likutay-eitzos: A Collection of Advice — practical guidance from Rebbe Nachman organized by topic, extracted from Likutay Moharan.
alim-litrufa: Letters of R' Nosson to his son and students — intimate spiritual guidance, encouragement, and practical wisdom.
yemei-moharnat: R' Nosson's travel diary and autobiography — a firsthand account of life as Rebbe Nachman's closest disciple.
shemos-hatzadikim: Names and yahrzeit dates of Breslov tzaddikim and their families — a memorial record.
yemei-hatlaos: Account of the persecutions suffered by R' Nosson and the early Breslov community.
hashtatfchus-hanefesh: Outpouring of the Soul — R' Alter of Teplik's guide to personal prayer (hisbodedus), the practice Rebbe Nachman considered most important.
meshivas-nefesh: Revival of the Soul — powerful encouragement for those struggling, teaching that no one is ever lost. A lifeline of hope.
parparos-lechochma: R' Nachman of Tcheryn's deep commentary connecting each teaching in Likutay Moharan to its Talmudic and Kabbalistic sources.
rimzei-hamaasiyos: Hints and allusions within Rebbe Nachman's 13 Stories — revealing the hidden spiritual dimensions of each tale.
otzar-hayirah: Treasury of Awe — R' Nachman of Tcheryn's encyclopedic work organizing Breslov teachings by topic across all the sefarim.
biur-halikutim: R' Avraham b'R Nachman's explanatory commentary on the more complex passages of Likutay Moharan.
chochma-utvuna: Wisdom and Understanding — R' Avraham b'R Nachman's exploration of deeper Kabbalistic themes in Rebbe Nachman's teachings.
kokhvei-or: Stars of Light — R' Avraham b'R Nachman's collected insights, stories, and customs of the Breslov tradition.
ebay-hanachal: Blossoms of the Stream — the letters of the Saba, R' Yisroel Ber Odesser, filled with fiery encouragement and Na Nach spirit.
siach-sarfei-kodesh: Conversations of Holy Angels — 6 volumes of collected sayings, stories, and customs from Breslov elders across generations.
fires-of-israel: The Fires of Israel — stories and teachings of the Saba, R' Yisroel Ber Odesser, who received the holy Petek.
chumash-lh: The weekly Torah portion illuminated through the lens of Likutay Halachos — connecting the Parsha to Breslov teachings.
kuntrass-hiskashrus: Tract on Binding to the Tzaddik — R' Yisroel Karduner's guide to connecting with Rebbe Nachman.
seven-pillars: The Seven Pillars of Faith — R' Yitzchak Breiter's systematic presentation of Breslov theology and practice.
hisbodidus-alone-time: Hisbodedus: Alone Time — an English compilation of Breslov teachings on personal prayer in solitude.
breiter-seder-hayom: R' Yitzchak Breiter's guide to the daily spiritual routine of a Breslov chassid.
likutay-nanach: Collected teachings about Na Nach Nachma Nachman — insights into the power and meaning of the holy name.
yisroel-saba: Teachings and stories of the Saba Yisroel, the discoverer of the Petek.
sichos-chayay-saba: Conversations from the life of the Saba — recorded discussions and personal guidance.
saba-tape-transcripts: Transcriptions of the Saba's recorded conversations — his voice preserved in text.
netzach-yisrael: Listen to 774 original recordings of Saba Yisroel, arranged into 22 topics and preserved on Internet Archive.
michtevay-shmuel: Letters of R' Shmuel Horowitz — correspondence of a devoted Breslov elder.
praises-of-rabbi-nachman: English presentation of Shivchay HaRan — the praises and remarkable episodes from Rebbe Nachman's life.
zimras-haaretz: Song of the Land — on the holiness of Eretz Yisrael in Breslov thought.
yikra-dshabbata: The Honor of Shabbos — Breslov teachings on the sanctity of the holy Shabbat.
yereach-haeitanim: Month of the Mighty — Breslov teachings on the month of Tishrei and the High Holidays.
nachas-hashulchan: Pleasure of the Table — Breslov customs and teachings related to meals and holy eating.
likutay-eitzos-basra: Later Edition of Likutay Eitzos — expanded collection of Rebbe Nachman's practical advice by topic.
azamra: Azamra — Live Up the Good Points — the powerful teaching to always find the good in yourself and others.
ramchal-mesillas-yesharim: Path of the Just — the Ramchal's classic step-by-step guide to spiritual refinement and closeness to Hashem.
ramchal-derech-hashem: The Way of God — the Ramchal's systematic theology explaining God's purpose in creation.
ramchal-daas-tevunos: Knowing the Reasons — the Ramchal's deep exploration of Divine providence and the purpose of good and evil.
chayey-moharan-hosafos: Addendum to Chayey Moharan — Kuntres HaHosafos, stories and traditions connected to Rebbe Nachman and the Baal Shem Tov, in Hebrew and English.
otzar-nachmani: Otzar Nachmani by R’ Nachman Yisroel Burstein — Breslov stories, traditions, and teachings preserved in Hebrew and English.
geedoolay-hanachal: Geedoolay HaNachal — a biographical register of early Breslov Chassidim and the chain of transmission, compiled by Noach HaLevi Sternfeld. STRONG TIMELINE INCLUDED: the book contains a panoramic timeline, charts/diagrams, yahrzeit tables, and dated Breslov historical material.
